mask_scope: VISIBLE SIDE GLASS APERTURE ONLY. Manual polygon follows the bright frame, excludes snow, painted C/A pillars, mirror and 4 mm glass meeting sash. This is not the vehicle's outer silhouette.
uncertainties: Reference is elevated perspective, not orthographic; rear axle and front axle are both manual anchors.
Both car ends are cropped and roof/hood covered in snow: full-car IoU, overhang and roof-error metrics are deliberately unavailable.
Manual glass trace estimated 3–8 source pixels; snow obscures portions of the lower seal. No exact millimetre result is allowed.
The front wheel has an aftermarket Mercury cover; it is not used as a Chevrolet wheel-detail reference.
